Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
3.

The applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.75 of 2020, under Section 302, 201, 419, 420, 482, 392,
411, 34 IPC at P.S. Vikas Nagar, District -Lucknow.

4. The first bail application of the applicant was rejected on 17.12.2020 mainly on the ground that the applicant had admitted his guilt in the confessional statement, the dead body of the victim and Santosh Kumar @ Babloo vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

the key was also recovered from the possession of the applicant.
The applicant is in custody since 12.3.2020.
This Court, while rejecting the bail application of the applicant, the trial court was expected to expedite the trial preferably within a period of one year.

5. Learned counsel for applicant has filed supplementary affidavit and stated that subsequent to the passing of the said bail order, the statements of as many as four witnesses were recorded and none of them have named the applicant implicating him with the offence in question.

It is argued that even otherwise, any of the name of the applicant did not surfaced subsequently on the basis of confessional statement and the alleged recovery, it was also not in accordance with the mandate of law.
6. Learned AGA vehemently opposed the bail application.
6. Considering the fact that the applicant is in jail since 12.03.2020 and has no previous criminal antecedent, has been implicated solely based upon confessional statement.
Subsequently, recording of the witnesses clearly demonstrates that the applicant was not name by them.

As many as 31 witnesses are proposed to be adduced by the prosecution and considering the fact that only four witnesses have been examined so far, there is no likelihood of trial to be completed in near future.
Considering the statements of the witnesses recorded subsequent to the bail order on record which do not implicate the applicant in question, the applicant is enlarged on bail.

7. Let the applicant Santosh Kumar @ Babloo released on bail in Case Crime No.75 of 2020, under Section 302, 201, 419, 420, 482, 392, 411, 34 IPC at P.S. Vikas Nagar, District -Lucknow on his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 -Amit K-
